name: Hob
gmNotes: A Hob or Hobgoblin is a semi-independent, middle-status rural maintenance contractor. Hobs sell received goods to laboratories or facilities and are not contractually barred from accepting gifts, though they may regard handouts as insulting. Their brown caps are dust-and-smoke filters. Some run occasional behavioural experiments, but they are not full-time domestic researchers like Boggarts. Hob is a fey-role Archetype, not a Species.
description: A rougher cousin of the household Brownie, associated with outdoor farm work and practical jokes.
